description:
It’s time for a Porsche Carrera GT to go up against a TWR Supercat! 

Explore new and used car deals with Carwow: https://bit.ly/Change-Your-Car-1508

How’s this for an almighty RWD drag race?! 

We’ve got Mat in a Porsche Carrera GT, and he’s lining up a prototype of a TWR Supercar! The question is, which will come out on top over the quarter-mile? Let’s take a closer look…

Starting with the Porsche, it’s powered by a 5.7-litre naturally-aspirated V1- that delivers 612hp and 590Nm. This power is sent to the rear wheels only via a 6-speed manual gearbox, and the car weighs in at 1,380kg. When it was first released, it cost around £330,000, but as of today, it’s valued at about £2,000,000!

Then we come to the TWR. It’s powered by a 5.6-litre supercharged V12, and this produces 660hp and 730Nm. This power is sent to the rear wheels via a 6-speed manual, and the car weighs in at 1,605kg - although they’re targeting 1,250kg for the final production car!
